# Generated by the ZIN content builder (tools/content/modules/diplomacy.mjs). Do not edit; change the data in tools/content/data/diplomacy*.json.
# Scope: a faction leader (called monthly). Records the size a league had when first seen (that size plus two is the target of Widen the League),
# counts the days of war in which no member lost a core state (Hold the Line) and, for the Concord, the dominions that keep faith (Common Defence).
zin_diplo_league_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_diplo_members = 1 }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_diplo_members = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = zin_diplo_league_target value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_diplo_league_target = zin_diplo_members }
		add_to_variable = { zin_diplo_league_target = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war = yes
			NOT = { collection_size = { input = collection:zin_faction_cores_lost value > 1 } }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_diplo_line_days = 30 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { zin_diplo_line_days = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_faction_template = zin_faction_concord } zin_diplo_concord_counters = yes }
}
# Scope: the Concord's leader. Writes the two global counters that its oath reads.
zin_diplo_concord_counters = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_diplo_concord_members = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_diplo_concord_loyal = 0 }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_diplo_concord_members = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_concord_loyalty value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_diplo_concord_loyal = 1 }
		}
	}
}
